name: paperscope
description: Local-first document search with exact page and line citations. Search your own documents offline via the paper CLI and its built-in MCP server.

paper_binary.title: paper binary path
paper_binary.description: Path to the paper binary. Leave blank to use `paper` from PATH, or set to ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/paper to use the bundled binary.

search_roots.title: Search roots
search_roots.description: Comma-separated directories paper should index and search. Empty means the configured Paper roots.

semantic_search.title: Enable semantic search
semantic_search.description: Use embedding-based semantic search when model weights are available. Falls back to keyword-only search otherwise.
